AC1.assessment: Complete scope/dedup/unknown semantics at DB and unit levels; actual chip/count/filter interaction is separately qualified browser scope.

AC2.assessment: Complete aggregate peers/recency/safe history and denied generic output are exercised; SSR earns structure only.

AC3.assessment: Actual move and matching-role reassignment suggestions selected through fresh preview/commit, old facts reject and fresh persistence succeeds; actual load, malformed/unknown, unrelated groups and spring/fall DST covered. Browser Flytta/Omfördela suggestion selection is not claimed; qualified API+unit coverage supports nonexhaustive essential smoke.

AC4.assessment: Actual reviewed move/reassign/adjust overlay, resolved versus remaining workflow/history and atomic failure are exercised.

AC5.assessment: Selective complete acceptance, nonblank reason, stale/unrelated/partial/domain negatives, no occurrence divergence, stable acceptance and returning identities are covered without crediting old skipped ATDD.

AC6.assessment: Durable ledger/audit/history, exact concurrent/replay result, changed content/revocation, real fault rollback, before/after recipients/preferences/event dedupe and email exclusion are exercised.

AC7.assessment: All12 current-segment slots, warnings beyond10, protected exception/tombstone rows, all10 ordinary sibling times/assignees, stable IDs/bounds, following successor and microseconds/all-day conversions are exercised.

AC8.assessment: Actual command/RPC/ledger authority, inactive/own/foreign/anonymous/multi-role controls, current-role wait/replay and transaction truth are covered. UI confirmation/input/explicit retry is qualified separately by browser packet, not by API/SSR.

epic_design_to_activated_ATDD.rule: Keys are epic scenario families, values are activated current IDs; do not equate family numbering/counts with executable test totals. Historical checklist is generation-time data, not current activation status.

limitations: Assessment is bounded to named Story15.3 coverage, not a fourth broad code-review round or exhaustive security/browser matrix. Three counted review rounds remain conserved.

SSR two static markup bodies earn no browser keyboard/layout credit. Flytta/Omfördela browser suggestion selection is not present in the essential smoke; actual production suggestions/commit are INT012 coverage.
